faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Assistant Manager – Business Development post at IIM Nagpur?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application form for the Assistant Manager – Business Development position at IIM Nagpur is 08 September 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Assistant Manager – Business Development role?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a First-class Post-Graduation degree in any discipline, preferably in Management, from a reputed Institute, along with significant relevant professional experience.

faq.question: Q3. What is the maximum age limit for applicants?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for applicants is 45 years.

faq.question: Q4. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q5. How many vacancies are available for the Assistant Manager – Business Development post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Assistant Manager – Business Development position.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for this role?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Assistant Manager – Business Development post will involve an Interview.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary structure for the selected candidate?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive an appropriate pay level as per the 7th Pay Commission.

faq.question: Q8. In which mode should the application be submitted?
faq.answer: Applications must be submitted online through the official IIM Nagpur website.

faq.question: Q9. Where is IIM Nagpur located?
faq.answer: IIM Nagpur is located in Nagpur, Maharashtra.

faq.question: Q10. What type of job is this recruitment for?
faq.answer: This is a Full Time job opportunity.
